borrowed: behaviour only — the two-level rail, sender grouping, the unread divider, the hover action bar and the keyboard. No ontology, no backend.
shape: four streams split into topics; each stream keeps its own outcome so one refusal does not empty the page
interaction: collapsible stream headers with a per-stream unread total
topics carry their own unread count and go bold until read
a 'new since you last opened this topic' divider, from localStorage
consecutive messages from the same sender collapse under one avatar
sticky day separators on the streams that record a time
hover action bar per message — react, quote, link, resolve
J/K message, N/P topic, End latest, / filter, Esc clear
jump-to-latest appears once you scroll away from the end
refusal_states: refused (401/403) — the stream shows a red dot and offers the session, its topics are not drawn
empty (200, no records) — an empty projection, named as one
failed (other) — nothing rendered rather than stale or invented
actions: offered, never submitted; the composer keeps your draft and says why it does not carry it

forbidden_inference: an occurrence -> work; the queue emitted it and nobody accepted it
a content change -> a meaningful change; the bytes differed, that is all
a read topic -> a handled one; unread state records where you stopped reading
a listed capability -> a purchased one; price is quoted at /mpp/quote and gated at 402
a reachable peer -> an endorsement; reachability is not agreement
a stream -> a chat feed; these are institutional occurrences, and none of them was addressed to you
requires_authority: a message into a stream is an effect on that stream; the composer keeps the draft and does not submit it
